objective: Improve geometric-mean UTF-8 validation and UTF-8->UTF-16LE transcoding throughput over a frozen fixed corpus of realistic mixed-script text at simdutf 1a62f928 while preserving the exact validation verdict and transcoded bytes, correct malformed-input rejection, and peak RSS.

meta.license: Apache-2.0 OR MIT (upstream LICENSE-APACHE and LICENSE-MIT preserved)
meta.provenance: Pinned public source simdutf/simdutf@1a62f928fcce103868d22df80376feea158060b9 (release v7.3.2 singleheader amalgamation); deterministic generated mixed-script UTF-8 corpora; current-head A-A qReference construction is frozen after local calibration.

sourceDetails.mutableSurface: src/simdutf.cpp (the SIMD scan/transcode kernels) and src/kernel.cpp (the validation+transcode driver over them); public headers, evaluator, trusted runner, build files, fixtures, and expectations are protected
sourceDetails.trustedHarness: hone/runner.cpp trusted candidate-invocation driver (dlopens the candidate library only after control-channel authentication; parent-timed; no self-reported throughput consumed)

measurement.platform: linux/arm64 Docker Desktop on Apple M3 Max
measurement.q: geometric mean over the frozen corpus files of the per-file candidate/reference speed ratio for combined UTF-8 validation + UTF-8->UTF-16LE transcoding; each file ratio is a min-of-N estimator (min candidate wall over N alternating reps / min reference wall), the contention-robust choice for ~1s legs under the shared Docker VM's persistent background contention (the differential load a within-pair geomean cannot cancel); wall measured in the trusted evaluator parent around a runner that dlopens the candidate ONLY after control-channel auth and reports no timing; the reference library is built from frozen trusted sources and timed adjacently; never a self-reported number from candidate-linked code. Timed iterations are byte-distinct: the trusted runner rewrites a sparse rotating subset of code points to same-length valid code points before every iteration after the first, and folds every iteration's verdict+transcoded bytes into a go-time-nonce-bound digest validated against the reference.
measurement.equalCoreBudget: every measured launch (reference and candidate legs alike) is clamped to the same single fixed CPU by the per-launch cgroup leaf's cpuset.cpus (kernel-owned; the demoted uid cannot write the control file and sched_setaffinity from inside is clamped to the cpuset), so a thread-parallel candidate cannot buy wall-clock throughput with cores the single-threaded reference never uses; preexec sched_setaffinity is the non-cgroup developer fallback
measurement.peakRssGate: candidate whole-tree peak RSS <= per-split frozen baseline (protected asset) * 1.05, measured as the kernel-owned cgroup2 memory.peak of a fresh per-launch leaf the candidate subtree joins before the privilege drop; the baseline is frozen near the observed whole-tree baseline peak (max over all launches of a full baseline eval, plus a small cross-run noise margin) so the gate binds against the true baseline on both splits
measurement.validationOracle: the in-eval trusted reference (built from sealed trusted sources, never candidate-linked) is the pristine payload + perturbed-digest oracle; each candidate launch runs in a fresh SysV-IPC namespace and candidate-writable residue (/tmp, /var/tmp, /dev/shm, SysV IPC) is purged between launches

normalization.status: provisional-local: 2x-consecutive bench-locked ordering on Apple M3 Max Docker (min-of-N, 8-lane fold, whole-tree cgroup memory.peak, single-core cpuset pin); qBase/sigma frozen from the pre-pin 6 baseline A-A aggregates; re-freeze via the planned like-for-like GCE re-baseline governs promotion (gate promotion on normalization.status==final)
